bantuan.backup.1: Open Backup & Sync and press Download backup. The file contains orders, menu, HPP, stock, and settings. Do it at least once a day, for example when closing the shift.
bantuan.backup.2: An encrypted backup is locked with a passphrase, so it is safe to keep in the cloud. Without the passphrase the file cannot be opened, so keep the passphrase somewhere safe.
bantuan.backup.3: Use restore after changing tablets or losing data. Choose a backup file (.json or .enc.json). Restore overwrites all orders on this tablet and cannot be undone, so check the chosen file first.
bantuan.backup.4: Sync to server is optional, for online summaries or several devices. The cashier keeps working without internet. The number of items not yet sent shows in the top bar.
bantuan.backup.description: Keep your data safe if the tablet has a problem.
bantuan.backup.title: Backup and restore
bantuan.cashier.1: Tap a menu item to add it to the order. Items with variants open a variant picker. Use the search box or pick a category to find an item.
bantuan.cashier.2: Change the quantity with the + and − buttons on the order line. Choose Dine in or Take away.
bantuan.cashier.3: Add an order note (it is printed on the receipt). If needed, enter a discount and tax in Rupiah with the Discount & tax button.
bantuan.cashier.4: The Hold button saves the order for later so the next customer can be served. Held orders appear in the order panel. Tap one to bring it back.
bantuan.cashier.5: Press Pay, then choose Cash, QRIS, or Other. For cash, enter the amount received and the change is calculated for you. For QRIS or Other, make sure the payment has arrived before pressing Complete.
bantuan.cashier.6: When payment succeeds, the receipt appears. Press Print receipt if a printer is connected. If printing fails, the order is still saved.
bantuan.cashier.description: From picking items to the receipt.
bantuan.cashier.title: Cashier: serving customers
bantuan.intro.description: A short guide to the main workflows. Everything is stored inside the app, so it opens without internet.
bantuan.intro.title: User guide
bantuan.refund.1: Open History. Find an order by receipt number or menu name, or filter by status.
bantuan.refund.2: Tap Detail to see the items and payment. The Print button reprints the receipt without creating a new order.
bantuan.refund.3: Orders with status Completed have Refund and Void buttons. Refund returns the stock and marks the order as refunded. Void cancels the order. Both are permanent and cannot be undone.
bantuan.refund.4: If the void PIN is enabled in Settings > Security, the app asks for the PIN first. After several wrong PINs, access is locked for a while.
bantuan.refund.title: Refunds and voids
bantuan.shift.1: Before you start selling, open Settings > Shift. Enter the opening cash in the drawer and press Open shift. The cashier name is changed in the Cashier section of Settings.
bantuan.shift.2: While a shift is running, the top bar shows the cashier name. The Shift section shows the number of orders and sales so far.
bantuan.shift.3: When you finish selling, press Close shift and confirm. The summary is calculated from all orders during the shift. A closed shift cannot be reopened. Open a new shift for the next session.
bantuan.shift.description: Opened and closed in Settings, under Shift.
bantuan.shift.title: Shift: drawer cash per session
bantuan.stock.1: The Stock screen only works in the Android app. In the browser (preview mode) it is unavailable.
bantuan.stock.2: Press Record purchase when you buy ingredients. Stock goes up and the latest price per unit is used as the recipe cost (HPP). The purchase unit can differ from the base unit, for example bought in kg and stored in g.
bantuan.stock.3: Use Correct stock for stock counts, spoiled ingredients, or shrinkage. Enter the difference (+ or −) and a reason. The reason is required so the record is clear.
bantuan.stock.4: Settings > Cashier has an option to reject sales when ingredient stock is not enough. When that option is off, sales still go through and stock can go negative.
bantuan.stock.title: Ingredient stock
